_comment: Triage verdicts for scripts/quality/security-pattern-sweep.py. Each entry means: a human looked at this
exact code and decided it is safe, and here is the reason. The key is a fingerprint of the matched TEXT,
so EDITING that code invalidates the verdict and the hit resurfaces -- which is the point.
Rationale for each rule id lives in docs/SECURITY_PATTERN_SWEEP_2026-07.md.
Never clear a hit here without recording why in that document.

b8e1b1a379d4.why: Value-coercion helper, not an authorization verdict: the catch converts 'this text is not a number/date/path' into 'absent', and every caller treats absent as not-supplied. No security decision is being answered here.

ffdc052c731c.why: IdentityRoleLookup.isTokenRevoked/rejectTvlessTokensNow: a malformed `tv` claim cannot be attacker-produced -- the claim is inside the JWT the server itself signed, so reaching the catch means the server emitted a non-numeric tv, not that a caller chose one. The system-property cutover parse is validated at boot by StartupValidator.

56abb5e304c9.why: Documented fail-CLOSED: a row-level access rule that will not evaluate denies. This is the correct direction and is explained in-line at the catch.

305525fd9cb1.why: Fail-closed: a hash that cannot be verified is not a match. Returning false is the only safe answer and no other outcome is reachable.
